news.text:
- Online Sealed: the build timer is shown while you open packs and build; a deck not finished in time forfeits and the opponent wins that round
- Online Draft and Sealed: every player is put into their round match at the same time (some were left waiting in the lobby)
- Online games stay quick late in the game (updates sent to players are much smaller)
- "There is no valid target" notice: an effect with nothing to target is skipped and the game carries on
- Buy packs 1, 5 or 10 at a time and open them one by one
- New achievement for completing the tutorial (150 coins)
- Draft: your drafted cards scroll and show a preview on hover
- Sealed deck builder: bigger, brighter page arrows
- AI players in events have their own avatars
- Hex spells from the AI no longer land on its own cards; online target choices fixed for cards that left the field
- Main menu mode cards: tidier sizes and hover
- Removed cards: Acolyte of Ewyn and Curious Bogal

- Sealed/Draft: after building you return to the lobby, pick the Leader for your next game and press Ready (before every round)
- Deck Editor: choose a sleeve (card back) for each deck; Default uses your Customize choice
- My Decks: right-click a deck to open, rename, move, copy its deck code or delete it
- Deck Editor, Sealed and Draft builders now match: big page arrows and card previews on deck-list rows; Randomize builds from your pool in Sealed/Draft
- Draft lists look like the Deck Editor's and show the card when you hover a row
- Player names are shown beside each Leader in matches
- Holding a card to inspect it in the Deck Editor takes 1.5 seconds
- Achievement and challenge notices wait until you're back at the menu or lobby
- The Emote button sits higher, clear of your Leader
- An attack now follows its target if an effect moves the field around (Eraser Gun hit nothing)
- Grave of Archenvale only counts Spirits; Totem of Life no longer triggers off Constructs (itself)
- Loony Llama no longer reacts to its own summon
- The opponent's graveyard choice (Curious Brushka) no longer opens on your screen
- Online: a card returned to hand (Gust of Wind) flies there instead of breaking and being drawn
- Buttons on a card (Re-equip) go away when you click elsewhere

- New battle music in every match
- News is now your inbox: patch notes for every update, unread markers, and gifts you can claim
- Loony Llama works as written: your play sets its ATK to 1, an opponent's play doubles it, and both changes last
- A once-per-turn ability that's already been used simply doesn't trigger again that turn
- Gust of Wind can target equipped Equipment (it goes back to its owner's hand)
- Vex lets you choose a non-Spirit, and that card is discarded (not erased)
- Devil on your Shoulder: the Spirit you take slides across the table instead of breaking apart

- Controller support: play the whole game with an Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo controller. A highlight moves between buttons and cards, and button marks match your controller
- Controller layout: A select, B back / No Guard, X hold to inspect, Y options, LB/RB jump between hand and sides or tabs, hold Menu to end your turn
- On-screen keyboard for naming decks and writing with a controller on PC
- New setting: Settings > Gameplay > Controller button prompts
- Sealed and Draft: you open a Leader Pack first (4 Leaders), and the other packs no longer contain Leaders
- Draft is now 6 packs (48 picks)
- Sealed and Draft: choose Standard or Epic packs for the whole run (hosts choose for online events)
- Sealed & Draft now share one main menu tile with a choice of the two; Tutorial sits under Play vs AI
- The Drafted list is wider, in the Deck Manager's look
- Deck Manager pages show four full rows of cards
- No Guard moved to the right side, where End Turn sits
- A card held up with its buttons stays in front of the rest of your hand
- Targeting highlights are tighter and a little softer
- Card inspector shows cards sharper
- Fixed: Feedback could not be sent
- Card update: Sea-Man, Ruler of the Depths

Spirit Masters 0.2.42

- Mobile menus, deck building, Match Setup and the battle HUD have more compact layouts, with fewer oversized controls and overlapping panels.
- Controller navigation now stays inside choices and targeting. Hand cards move in order, raised cards lower when you move away, and B rests the same card without raising its neighbour.
- Hold Y to end your turn; tap Y to minimize or restore a choice overlay. Minimize and End Turn are no longer directional focus stops. Start opens the match menu.
- Controller button icons are larger. Summon and Play buttons have a cleaner design, appear highlighted immediately, and their outlines follow the card throughout its lift.
- Opening hands start with the middle card highlighted. Card highlights follow their actual shapes, stay behind inspection previews, and remain inside scrolling lists such as the graveyard.
- Favorite decks from their options menu: starred decks appear first in My Decks and deck selection. The editor shows Unsaved changes beside the deck name and only asks before closing when edits remain unsaved.
- Deck boxes have visual cosmetic choices and an opening three-card showcase. Deck displays are larger and keep showcase cards clear of the folder panel.
- Test opening hands and mulligans in the deck editor, with expanded deck statistics and NRG charts.
- Card inspection explains current stats, counters and temporary modifiers, including their sources and expiry.
- Effects wait for the action they react to, including its animations, to finish. Grave of Archenvale waits until the current effect finishes resolving, including all Wicked Donation discards.
- Milling now moves a face-down card from the deck to the graveyard and flips it face-up before landing. Overrun damage has its own presentation, and attack declarations no longer grey out the field.
- Mobile effect choices and pending-effect details take up less of the board. Invalid effect targets are easier to distinguish, and Match Setup cards can be inspected on each input device.
- Controller ownership persists until real mouse movement. Resting the mouse over the hand no longer raises another card or cancels a menu tile's controller hover.
- Card Editor timing filters support more detail, including fixed-number and card-to-card comparisons. Updated card data and artwork are included.
- Lower default music loudness and green ready-to-attack highlights.
- Removed the VFX Forge editor and its unused presets.

0.2.43
- New mode: Cube. Build your own cube (up to 4 copies of a card, sized for 2-8 players), share it with a cube code, then play it as a Draft or Sealed run. Cube cards are only for the run.
- Leader mastery: win with a Leader to level it up to mastery 10. Every level pays coins; level 5 gives its full-art sleeve, level 10 its title and a Shatterfoil Rare of the Leader. Mastery badges show beside Leaders in matches and on profiles.
- Collection milestones: Progress > Collection tracks each colour and BP01. Coins at 25/50/75/100%; a full colour gives its Mastery frame and playmat, and with its colour challenge done, its title.
- Spectate: a friend's profile now has a Spectate button while they play, including games against the AI.
- New Overrun and Bite animations.
- The AI no longer guards every attack on a healthy Leader.
- Fixed: a Leader brought to 0 HP by Overrun, paid life or Burn now loses the game.
- Fixed an error flood in the game log.
- Card inspector: hold for 1 second, or press Z / X on a controller to open and close it.
- Shattered Rares are now called Shatterfoil Rares.

0.2.44
- New card moments: animations for stealing, sacrifices, Cataclysm flips, copies, tokens, Equipment, heals and the start of each turn.
- 12 new solid-colour sleeves with no symbols, in Customize.
- Mr Skeltal now plays his own sound when he attacks or uses his effect.
- Forgot password: reset it from the sign-in screen with a code sent to your email.
- Messages: the box stays ready to type after sending, there's an emoji button, and you can report a player or a single message from the chat.
- The AI finishes off weakened Spirits with damage spells instead of chipping healthy ones.
- Inspecting a card in the Deck Manager shows the deck's own sleeve on its back.
- Fixed: the game could crash on a lethal attack.
- Fixed: saving a deck made a new copy of it each time; it now saves over the deck you loaded (renaming it renames it).
- Fixed: "destroys a Spirit" and other Spirit-only effects triggered on Constructs (Aggressive Ostrich).
- Fixed: Captain Sinclair's prompt could appear before the attack had finished playing.
- Fixed: re-cropped card art showed its old crop in prompts and pickers.
- Fixed: Silly Goose now triggers on any attack, as its text says.

0.2.45
- New mode: Roguelike. Pick a Leader, open 2 standard packs and 1 elite pack, build a deck and climb a 10-fight ladder to a random boss. You choose each next opponent from a few options.
- Earn coins as you go and spend them in the merchant's shop on packs, relics, charms and services. Card picks, events, upgrades and cursed relics come along the way.
- Over 100 relics: every Leader starts with a themed relic, and there are relic sets with bonuses for owning 2 or 3 of them, plus relics that boost Spirits with no effects.
- Enemies carry their own relics: small ones on normal fights, better ones on mini-bosses and the boss.
- Charms: single-use items bought in the shop and used on your turn (heal, draw, NRG, damage and more).
- After beating the boss, keep going in Endless mode with stronger rounds. Ascension levels, a Relic Codex with unlockable relics, Run History and Roguelike titles track your runs.
- Hand limit: at the end of your turn you discard down to 10 cards.
- Cube editor: Save stays on screen on phones however big the cube gets, a card size slider on phones, a hover preview you can turn off on PC, card inspect on every device, and add or remove 1-4 copies per click.
- Deck editors have a "Card preview" switch next to Randomize deck to turn off the hover preview.
- Sealed and Draft events can be played for an entry fee with pack and coin prizes for the top 3, or as Free Play.
- Leaders start face down and flip at the start of a match. Cards that stop a named card from being played show a notice on the board.
- Fixed: on phones, inspecting a card could flip it around as soon as you dragged it.
- Fixed: the opening hand draw animation played twice in some modes.
- Updated card data and new card art.

0.2.46
- Roguelike: the Leader screen's starting relic text no longer spills out of its box.
- Roguelike on phones: the Leader screen fits on one screen, so the Leader's cards, both starting relics and the Start Run button are all visible.

0.2.47
- Roguelike: Grave Secrets (Vespera's starting relic) now reads "Once per game: you can summon a Spirit from the graveyard." Tap it during your turn to use it.
- Roguelike: relics you can use glow and give a little shake while they're ready.
- Roguelike Leader screen: every Leader's cards always show as cards, and on phones the screen fits without running off the side.
- Your profile now opens above the creators' message on the main menu.
- Roguelike balance changes from the developers can now reach your game without an update.

Spirit Masters 0.2.48
A fresh look for the news, and a cleaner Roguelike tuning screen for the creators.

=== NEW | Patch notes, redone | art: Hold That Thought
- Updates in **News** now open as a full page: one card per topic, each with its own art.
- Notes are grouped into **New**, **Changes** and **Fixes**, so you can find what matters to you.
- After an update, its notes **open by themselves** the first time you reach the main menu. Closed, they stay in News.

=== MODE | Roguelike: spin for your reward | art: Treasure Trove
- After a win, **card reels** spin through the deck you just beat and land on a card each: **1** after the first fight, **2 or 3** after normal fights, **4** after a mini-boss. Keep one, or skip.
- **Reroll** any reel for coins. It never lands on the same card twice in a row.
- Every run, won or lost, ends with a **run snapshot**: your Leader, the ladder, your numbers, relics, every fight and your deck. Save it as a picture on PC.

=== CHANGES | Roguelike relics | art: Grave of Archenvale
- **Grave Secrets** (Vespera Grimwold): once per game, you can summon a Spirit from the graveyard. Tap it on your turn.
- Relics you can use **glow and shake** while they're ready.

=== FIXES | Screens that fit
- The Roguelike Leader screen always shows every Leader's cards and fits on phones.
- Your profile opens above the creators' message on the main menu.

=== CARDS | Card updates | art: K317 - The Decider
- **K317 - The Decider**: when a Spirit would be destroyed and K317 is ready, you're asked first. Say yes to exhaust K317 and **erase** that Spirit instead, so its "when destroyed" effects don't happen.
- **Starbrite**'s text now shows its target: a Spirit an opponent controls with **4 or less ATK**.
- **Silly Goose** triggers on **any attack**, Leaders included, as its text says.
- New art for Blanca, Lobo, Goblin Bruiser, Man-Eater Plant, Mutated Frog, Universal Archivist, Z - The Magician and more, plus the latest balance changes.

Spirit Masters 0.2.49
New cards, new Roguelike Leaders, and every reward card is yours to keep.

=== CARDS | New cards | art: Peekaboo Tower
- **Peekaboo Tower** replaces Merry-Go-Round: when an opponent's Spirit attacks, exhaust it to **ready** one of your exhausted Spirits. Then the tower takes 1 damage.
- **Gobsmacked** replaces Shake Down: target Spirit **can't guard** until your next turn.
- **Invigorate** replaces Stolen Valor: **heal 2** damage from target Spirit, and it gains **+2 ATK** until your next turn.
- Rune Crown is now **The King's Folly**, with new art.
- Decks that held a replaced card get the new card automatically.

=== BALANCE | Card updates | art: Silly Goose
- **Silly Goose** now triggers only when it attacks a **Spirit**, not a Leader.
- Art and animation touch-ups for **Erase** and **Alluring Mermaid**.
- New art for Dathariel, Galen Armas, Gornak, Gren-Goblin Initiate, Happy Quokka, Healing Herbivore, Helpful Faevela, Temple in the Sky, Wolf Pup and more.

=== MODE | Roguelike: more to keep | art: Treasure Trove
- Runs start with **4 packs** instead of 3.
- After a win, you can keep the card from **every reel**, not just one. Click a reel to leave its card out.
- Reward, event and shop cards go into your **collection**, marked NEW in Edit Deck, so you decide what goes in your deck.
- Events show the cards they gave you.
- New Leaders: **Captain Sinclair of the Black Sea** (Grave Treasures: +10% coins per fight) and **K317 - The Decider**.

=== CHANGES | Smoother screens | art: Hold That Thought
- **Open Next Pack** now appears where Skip was, so you can open pack after pack without crossing the screen.
- My Decks no longer lists your Sealed, Draft and Roguelike run decks.

=== FIXES | Fixes | art: Virus Injector
- **Virus Injector** on an opponent's Spirit goes back to its owner when that Spirit leaves.
- The Roguelike enemy relic **Blood Fang** works as written.

Spirit Masters 0.2.50
A quick fix for Silly Goose.

=== FIXES | Silly Goose, back to normal | art: Silly Goose
- **Silly Goose** triggers on **any attack** again, Leaders included, as its text says. 0.2.49 had it only on attacks at Spirits by mistake.

Spirit Masters 0.2.51
New wolves, mystery Roguelike opponents, and fairer "must attack" rules.

=== CARDS | New cards | art: Blanca, Mother Wolf
- **Blanca, Mother Wolf**: {O}, when a Spirit you control with 3 or less NRG is destroyed, put a **+1 ATK Counter** on Blanca. If it was a **Wolf**, put two instead.
- **Lobo, the Grayfather**: Wolf Spirits you control with 6 or less NRG gain **Overrun**. When Lobo destroys an opponent's Spirit, put a +1 ATK Counter on another Wolf you control.
- Complacency is now **Dampen**, Misplaced Memory is now **Out of Sight**, and Skill: Dismantle is now **Dismantle**. Decks swap to the new cards automatically.

=== BALANCE | Card updates | art: Furious Boar
- Updates to **Furious Boar**, **Frog Lee**, **Banana Slinger**, **Starved Wolf**, **Howling Wolf**, **Ravaging Wolf** and more.
- New art for Chronoworm, Guard Duty, Dampen, Dismantle, Out of Sight, Change of Plans, Make My Monster Grow!, Red Wyvern, Share the Pain, Creature Cannon, Mutant Stag and The White Stag.

=== MODE | Roguelike: mystery opponents | art: Canopy Scout
- Normal fights are now **mystery opponents**: you find out who it is when the duel starts. Mini-bosses and the boss still show their Leader, HP and relics.
- New shop relic **Spyglass** reveals every opponent's Leader, difficulty, deck theme and key cards.
- Tap an opponent to fight them, on phones too. The fight starts straight away with no extra setup screen.

=== RULES | Must attack means must attack | art: Berserk Baboon
- If a Spirit that **must attack if able** hasn't attacked yet, you can't make a play that would push NRG over and end your turn. That covers cards, abilities, equips and summons from other zones. The game tells you which Spirit has to attack first.

=== FIXES | Fixes | art: Throne of Malphas
- Spells and effects stay in the spotlight until they finish, instead of leaving and showing up a second time.
- **Throne of Malphas** no longer triggers when a Goblin is destroyed.
- The deck editor no longer shows old art for some cards.

Spirit Masters 0.2.52
Roguelike on the main menu, new deck-building music, and Circle of Life.

=== MODE | Roguelike on the main menu | art: Here or There
- The Roguelike now has its own card on the main menu. A run in progress shows **Continue Run** right there.
- Nemesis moved to the **Play vs AI** card, next to Tutorial.
- Relics that share a set now **fuse** into a stronger relic once you hold every piece. The set's bonuses stay on after fusing.
- Some relics were renamed so they aren't confused with cards: **Mender's Band**, **Idol of Vitality** and **Sky Temple Bell**.
- **Mimic's Mirror** now copies the first Spirit your opponent summons each game, as its text says (it was copying one every turn).

=== MUSIC | New music | art: Circle of Life
- A new deck-building theme plays in the Deck Editor, Play vs AI setup, the PvP and Online screens, and while opening packs, drafting and between Roguelike fights.
- Songs now fade into each other instead of cutting off.
- Screens that used to be silent (Online, Roguelike between fights, Cube) now have music.

=== CARDS | Card updates | art: Circle of Life
- **Nature's Rejoice** is now **Circle of Life**, with new art. Decks swap to the new card automatically.
- New art for **Hold That Thought** and **Wild Fury**.

=== FIXES | Fixes | art: Throne of Malphas
- The update screen no longer shows the raw patch notes text (they're in News now).

Spirit Masters 0.2.53
New card art, Red Wyvern, and a Roguelike shop that fits on screen.

=== CARDS | New card art | art: The Grin Reaper
- New art for **Bitter Reward**, **Energy Conduit**, **Gummi Fish**, **Gust of Wind**, **Kragen the Warleader**, **Magi the Magnificent**, **Majestic Unicorn**, **Mental Shock**, **Mister Robardo**, **Mousephant**, **Mystic Reclaimer**, **Na'ma Geoff**, **Red Piranha**, **Rubber Ducky of Death**, **Smoke Elemental**, **Spit**, **The Banana King**, **The Grin Reaper**, **Undertow**, **Unexpected Rogue Train**, **Verdant Ranger**, **Vespera Grimwold, Death Whisperer**, **Viola, Seeker of Secrets**, **Virus Injector** and **Wet Floor Sign**.
- New card: **Red Wyvern**.
- Card balance and wording updates from the latest live edits.

=== FIXES | Fixes | art: Red Wyvern
- The Roguelike shop now resizes its cards to fit on screen, however many are for sale.
